title: DAG Priority Topological Sorter & Bounded Retry Runner (With Regression Guard)
promptSingle: Implement `topo_sort_prioritized(deps, priorities)` in `scheduler/dag.py` (deterministic priority order, higher priority first, tie-break lexicographically by task_id, raise ValueError on cycle, without breaking existing `has_cycle`) and `run_with_retries(fn, max_retries)` in `scheduler/runner.py` (retries on Exception up to max_retries additional attempts and records attempt count). Existing `tests/test_existing.py` must continue to pass.

roles.prompt: You are dag_dev. Implement ONLY `topo_sort_prioritized(deps, priorities)` in `scheduler/dag.py`: deps maps task_id -> list of prerequisite task_ids; higher priority runs earlier when ready; tie-break by task_id ascending; raise ValueError if a cycle exists. Do NOT break existing `has_cycle` or edit `scheduler/runner.py`.

You are runner_dev. Implement ONLY `run_with_retries(fn, max_retries=2)` in `scheduler/runner.py`: call `fn()`, retrying on Exception up to `max_retries` additional times (total attempts <= 1 + max_retries). Return `{'status': 'ok', 'result': val, 'attempts': n}` on success, or `{'status': 'failed', 'error': str(exc), 'attempts': n}` when exhausted. Do NOT edit `scheduler/dag.py`.
